ValidationRule.description: A Drive Date change cannot change to cross a Taxonomy effective date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISNEW() ) && ISCHANGED( sked_Drive_Date__c ) && NOT( ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE( sked_Drive_Date__c ) ) ) && ( ISBLANK( sked_Drive_Date__c ) || ( PRIORVALUE( sked_Drive_Date__c ) < DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") && sked_Drive_Date__c >= DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") ) || ( PRIORVALUE( sked_Drive_Date__c ) >= DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") && sked_Drive_Date__c < DATEVALUE("2024-01-22") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive Date change interferes with Taxonomy effective dates. Please cancel and rebook. Any scheduled donors should be managed through the Notifying Donors of Drive Change policy.
